message.reasoning_content:
The image shows a rose gold Vacheron Constantin Overseas with a moon phase and complete calendar (day, date, month) — that's the Overseas Perpetual Calendar Ultra-Thin, or the Overseas "Complete Calendar" 4000V/210R-B966? Let me think.

Actually the dial shows: day of week, month, date, moon phase — that's a complete calendar (annual-ish). Vacheron Constantin Overseas Perpetual Calendar Ultra-Thin is reference 4300V/120R-B064 (with moon phase and perpetual calendar). But this dial layout — subdial at top with month/leap year? Let's look: There's a date scale... Actually the dial has 31-date scale in the center? Hmm.

The Overseas Perpetual Calendar Ultra-Thin (4300V/120R-B064) has a blue dial with 3 subdials + moon phase. The Complete Calendar in Overseas is the ref 4000V/210R-B966 — "Overseas Complete Calendar" with 41mm rose gold, silvered dial, moon phase, day and month subdials, date by pointer hand on outer track. Yes! That matches: the dial shows an outer date track with a pointer, day subdial (MWED TUE...) and month subdial with moon at top and date pointer.

Actually the layout here: top subdial has moon phase and month? At the bottom there is "MWED TUE SAT SO..." — day subdial at bottom-left? Let me reconsider.

Vacheron Constantin Overseas Complete Calendar 4000V/210R-B966: 41mm pink gold, silver dial, complete calendar with moon phase, 2460 QCL movement. Hmm, actually the day subdial shows letters "MWED" resembling "WED TUE" reversed... The photo is a mirror image? Text "VACHERON CONSTANTIN" appears mirrored ("NAHC..." reversed). Indeed "NITNATSNOC NORAHC AV" — the image appears mirrored. The "MWED TUE" is "WED TUE" reversed... hmm, "TUE WED" would be normal. So it's a mirrored image.

Anyway. The complete calendar Overseas reference: 4000V/210R-B966 (pink gold, silver dial). Let me recall: The Overseas "Complete Calendar" in pink gold with silvered dial — ref. 4000V/210R-B966. There's also the Overseas Perpetual Calendar Ultra-Thin 4300V/120R-B064 with blue dial, and 4300V/120R-B509? Hmm.

Also there's Overseas Complete Calendar with blue dial 4000V/210R-B967? Hmm. I believe the silvered-dial complete calendar is 4000V/210R-B966? Actually I recall ref 4000V/210R-B967 was pink gold with silver dial... Let me think more carefully.

Vacheron Constantin Overseas Complete Calendar: launched ~2018? Reference 4000V/210R-B966 — pink gold, silver dial? I'm fairly confident the silver-dialed rose gold Overseas Complete Calendar is 4000V/210R-B966. Hmm, but there's also 4000V/210R-B967 in blue.

Actually I recall: 4000V/210R-B966 has a silvered dial; 4000V/210R-B967 has a blue dial? Some sources: Overseas Complete Calendar 4000V/210R-B966 (rose gold, silver dial). I'll go with that, confidence ~0.5.

Movement: automatic.

Case material: gold (rose/pink gold).

Bracelet: metal (rose gold bracelet). The spec asks bracelet_material one of leather, metal, rubber, fabric, nylon — "metal".

Note: the watch is on a rose gold bracelet, which is unusual for the complete calendar (usually leather). Hmm — wait, the bracelet shown looks like the Overseas bracelet in rose gold. But the complete calendar shipped with leather strap and an additional bracelet? The Overseas collection ships with interchangeable straps and bracelet. Actually the complete calendar 4000V/210R-B966 comes on leather strap with an additional rubber strap; but the Overseas bracelet may be sold separately. Anyway "metal".

Hmm, but wait — could this be the Overseas Perpetual Calendar Ultra-Thin 4300V/120R-B064? That one has blue dial, with subdials: month/leap year at 3? Actually the 4300V has moon phase at 6, date subdial... The picture: outer date scale with pointer is characteristic of the complete calendar (2460 QCL/1). Also the perpetual calendar Overseas has date by subdial, not pointer? The 4300V Ultra-Thin Perpetual Calendar has: moon phase at 6, subdials for month, date, day arranged, and a small leap year. Hmm.

The image clearly shows a center date pointer on an outer 1-31 track plus day and month subdials and moon phase — the classic complete calendar layout. So Overseas Complete Calendar 4000V/210R-B966.

Bracelet: I'd say metal.

Confidence ~0.45.
